_comment: The corpus both E2 figures report over: the proteins E1 ran that E2 also screened. Derived by pipelines/scripts/e2/draft_panel_a.py as POP = SCREENED & E1, which is what panel (a) of the composite plate counts; composite_data.py asserts its own POP equals this list, so the two cannot drift. Committed rather than recomputed because deriving it reads E1's 554 MB sweep, which is not in E2's deposit.
_derived: 2026-11-02 from E2's screen catalog and the E1 sweep of 2026-10-27, plus P22301 and P41159, which were added to E1 after that snapshot and are named explicitly in draft_panel_a.py.
